finding_summary: Built a new training config, NOT reusing the verification-only saclb_campaign_m41fix_test.yaml and NOT touching any saclb_campaign*_v2.yaml submission record. urllc ratio range 6/7/8 (floor/nominal/cap) derived to map raw_prbs exactly to M44-D's confirmed band bottom/top (6-8 raw PRB). embb ratio range 5/7/10 derived to map exactly to M44-E2b's confirmed band (5-10 raw PRB). mmtc's range collapsed to a single fixed point (5/5/5, exactly min_rbSize) rather than given a fake graded range, since M44-E1/E1b established no realistic controllable band exists for it; the fixed value matches the specific point M44-E1 confirmed mmtc serves cleanly at, at native load. All non-ratio fields (reward weights, QoE coeffs, arrivals, episode length) carried over unchanged from saclb_campaign_v2_offline_train.yaml -- out of scope for this milestone.

Reused m42_floor_matrix.py's own raw_prbs()/parse_slices() helpers (same N_RB_SCHED_INIT=106/MIN_RBSIZE=5 constants, same conversion cited from gNB_scheduler_dlsch.c) rather than re-deriving arithmetic independently. Enumerated every integer ratio point in each slice's [floor,cap] range (not assumed linear from endpoints) to find the actual distinct raw-PRB values expressible. Result: urllc expresses exactly {6,7,8} (3 points, matches M44-D exactly); embb expresses exactly {5,6,7,8,9,10} (6 points, matches M44-E2b exactly); mmtc fixed at {5} (1 point, by design). Independently cross-checked the new config also loads cleanly through the real, frozen qoe_oran_framework.config.load_saclb_config() (the loader MR2's actual training code will use), values identical.

Both controllable slices (urllc, embb) are fully in-band (every reachable ratio value maps to a raw-PRB value inside that slice's own live-measured band, none below the 5-PRB scheduler floor, none above the band's own measured top) AND multi-point-graded (range width is not collapsed to one PRB -- 3 and 6 distinct points respectively, matching the exact point counts M44-D/M44-E2b already tested live). Per the milestone's own decision tree: config confound resolved statically. PF2-0's SECOND confound (ClosedLoopKpmSource's lack of cross-slice coupling) remains open, explicitly out of scope for MR1 by design. GATE MR1 reported -- awaiting go before MR2 (offline retrain under this fixed config).
